arm_semantics.RESET_K: K calls each on original z and z[successor], discard prior

determinism.objective: mean 4-class cross entropy on final FP32 start-node logits
determinism.training_order: epoch 0..15, depth 1..4, arm order; one forward/backward/clip/step per batch

module_spec.readout: Linear(128,4,bias=True) on indexed start vector only

cap0_probe_selection.selection_rule: for each depth 1..4 choose lexicographic minimum (order_key_sha256,row_id) among fit rows

metric_formulas.mean: math.fsum in frozen order divided by count

threshold_builder_contract.heldout_threshold_binding: same frozen thresholds; heldout only after validation passes and a separate final contract
